pairs.l: 1 — Thanks for the invitation, but I'm stuck at the office.
2 — All games are strictly prohibited. Offenders will be punished.
3 — Don't let your nerves win. Chill.
4 — In the event of any damage, the company will not take blame.
5 — These guys are professionals, with years of experience.
pairs.r: D — They know what they're doing.

r1.exp: Poruka 1 (zapela na poslu, ne mogu doći) = C (I can't make it). Poruka 2 (igre zabranjene, prekršitelji će biti kažnjeni) = B (They are not allowed). Poruka 3 (opusti se na ispitu) = E (Relax). Poruka 4 (firma ne preuzima odgovornost za štetu) = A (We are not responsible). Poruka 5 (profesionalci su, znaju što rade) = D (They know what they're doing).

r6.exp: Završava rad u 17:00, daje si 45 minuta za put → 17:00 + 0:45 = 17:45 (B = At 5.45).

r7.exp: 'If I don't get some sun after these gloomy months, I will go crazy' → želi sunce/dobro vrijeme = A (Because of the weather).

r8.exp: Edward pita 'can you suggest the best way to GET TO the Taj Mahal?' → traži upute za prijevoz/transport (B = Transport directions).

r9.exp: Lucy kaže 'to say such things to MY MOTHER!' → Tony je kritizirao njezinu majku, što ju je posramilo (C).

r10.exp: 'Mixed bag... all four seasons at once... rainy one moment, sunny the next' → promjenljivo (A = Changeable).

r11.exp: Preselila se u London sa 16 godina, a sada je 5 godina poslije → 16 + 5 = 21 godina.

r12.exp: 'Although I was born there' — 'there' se odnosi na London → Ariel je rođena u Londonu.

r13.exp: 'Where I work as a receptionist' → sadašnji posao je receptionist (u bolnici).

r14.exp: 'I started working as a fitness instructor but I soon quit' → prethodni posao je fitness instructor.

r15.exp: 'The film Splash played a huge part in my childhood and I spent lots of time under water' → inspirativni film je Splash.

r16.exp: 'Small changes you can introduce into your daily life (16)____. And they can save you a lot of money.' → C: that take very little time or effort. Male promjene koje ne zahtijevaju puno truda.

r17.exp: 'When throwing away objects, think about (17)____.' → B: which of them can be recycled (koji se mogu reciklirati).

r18.exp: 'Only buy things (18)____. In a consumer culture, it's easy to fall into the habit of overbuying.' → A: that you actually need and use (koje stvarno trebaš i koristiš).

r19.exp: 'Reduce your shower time (19)____.' → E: because that can save more than you'd think (jer to može uštedjeti više nego što misliš).

r20.exp: 'You can end animal testing for good (20)____.' → F: if you stop buying from companies that use it (ako prestaneš kupovati od tvrtki koje ga koriste).

r21.exp: 'The frequency... IS increasing' — subjekt je 'frequency' (jednina) → prezent kontinuirani: is + gerund.

r22.exp: 'Was struck BY extreme flooding' — pasivna konstrukcija: be struck by (agent se uvodi s 'by').

r23.exp: 'Humanitarian crisis AFTER being hit by drought' — kriza je nastala nakon što je Sudan pogođen sušom i glađu.

r24.exp: 'We CAN see that more drastic changes influence specific locations' — modalni glagol sposobnosti/mogućnosti u sadašnjosti: can.

r25.exp: 'Events SUCH AS sudden hail and flash floods' — fiksni izraz za primjer: 'such as' = kao što su.

r26.exp: 'It HAS evolved' — present perfect: has + past participle. Evolucija je počela u prošlosti i relevantna je danas.

r27.exp: 'Think OF sushi chefs as...' — fiksna prijedložna kolokacija: think of someone/something as.

r28.exp: 'With A wide variety of seafood' — neodređeni član 'a' uz 'wide variety'.

r29.exp: 'Combined with rice and vegetables TO create sushi' — infinitiv svrhe: 'to create'.

r30.exp: 'Must BE fresh' — modalni glagol 'must' + infinitiv bez 'to': must be.

sol.rubric: Odgovori na sva 3 pitanja: (1) što je Jack propustio u školi, (2) što je učitelj rekao o školskom izletu, (3) što se dogodilo na školskom finalu u nogometu. Dužina 50–70 riječi. Neformalan registar.

w1.exp: Pisani zadatak — nema jednog točnog odgovora. Ocjenjuju se sadržaj (odgovori na sva pitanja), jezik i dužina (50–70 riječi).
